rubric.scale: Ordinal 0–3 by dimension; not an accuracy percentage and not an interval/ratio scale. Do not sum or convert to percent.

levels.0: Mechanism absent or no credible representation in the assessed scope

levels.2: Some visible reference criteria match; significant unmeasured limitations remain

changes: Replaced release-order/Mimosa-first index with domain/kingdom/phylum/class sections and alphabetical lower ranks; full species binomials are primary labels.

Third checkpoint: six coral/anemone/Hydra corrections add continuous coral surfaces, irregular fan topology, dense attached tentacle crowns and local basal-anchored Hydra contraction. Original real photographs and source assets are unchanged.

Rejected the older sea-fan source passage about stony-coral cups/septa as octocoral anatomy; separated genome context from Hydra motion evidence. Smithsonian indexed objects and inaccessible papers are not counted as fully retrieved collection determinations.

Snail classification-only links and collected/opened shell photographs have explicit source-scope cautions.

Fifth checkpoint: female Daphnia and five sea stars receive distinct continuous bodies/surface cues and attached partial appendage motion. Five thoracic limb pairs follow primary Daphnia anatomy; pointed Astropecten feet have no discs. Two direct Smithsonian collection labels were checked without specimen redetermination; the crown-of-thorns authority disagreement remains explicit.
limitations: The requested 90% biological accuracy has not been established. No specialist credentials, independent review, measured biomechanics, photogrammetry or organism physiology are implied.

A single photograph cannot determine all three-dimensional anatomy, population/sex/life-stage variation or a movement cycle. Screenshots and software contact constraints do not constitute biological validation.

ITIS is a Smithsonian-partnered resource, not a direct Smithsonian collection determination. Direct institutional name references are individually identified; complete collection/common-name verification remains pending.

Generic/common labels vary by source and language. Exact ITIS string matches can be synonyms; absence from a database does not establish invalidity. Species-complex and broad nominal concepts still need specialist resolution.
Reference photographs are real, separately credited source images. Authored pigment fields are not photographs. Source model and image licenses/checksums are retained.
Previous review links remain available, but are not counted as fresh review in this checkpoint. Source references are traceability links, not a claim that every cited paper was reread in full.
